title: 2026 Membranoproliferative Glomerulonephritis (膜狀增殖性腎絲球腎炎) 機轉分類、C3G 與 Ig-mediated 鑑別、KDIGO 指引與臨床實戰

sections.title: Histopathologic Paradigm & IF Classification of MPGN Pattern of Injury
sections.content:
MPGN 並非單一特異性疾病，Pattern of Injury。LM 下，典型表現為 Glomerular Lobular Accentuation、Mesangial Hypercellularity、GBMGBM Doubling or Tram-Track Appearance。此 Tram-Track 景象係由於 Mesangial Cytoplasm 延伸入 Subendothelial Space  並伴隨新 GBM 物質沉積所致。

現代腎病理學 EM 切分之 Type I, Type II, Type III 機械分類，IF 為核心之機轉分類學：

###Topology Mapping Matrix

| Classification Category |IF Profile | Pathophysiologic Mechanism | Representative Etiologies |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Immune-Complex / Ig-Mediated MPGN** |IgG/IgA/IgM +C3/C4 co-deposition | Classical Complement Pathway activation via Antigen-Antibody complexes or Monoclonal Ig | Chronic Infections (HCV, HBV, Infective Endocarditis), Autoimmune (SLE, Cryoglobulinemia), Monoclonal Gammopathy (MGRS, PGNMID) |
| **Complement-C3G** | C3 Dominant (C3 intensity $\ge 2$ orders higher than Ig) |AP dysregulation / uncontrolled amplification | Autoantibodies (C3NeF, Anti-Factor H), Genetic mutations (CFH, CFI, CFHR1-5) |
| **Dense Deposit Disease (DDD, former MPGN Type II)** | C3 Dominant with intramembranous osmiophilic ribbon-like deposits | Severe AP C3 convertase stabilization | C3NeF, Acquired Partial Lipodystrophy, Retinal Drusen |
| **C3GN** | C3 Dominant with mesangial/subendothelial/subepithelial deposits | AP C3/C5 convertase dysregulation | C3NeF, C5NeF, Anti-Factor H, CFHR gene duplication |

此 IF 分型架構直接決定臨床排查與標靶治療方向。若 IF 證實為 Ig 陽性，應立即著手排查 Infections, Autoimmune 及 Monoclonal Gammopathy；C3 Dominant，則代表替代補體途徑失調，需進行補體基因與自體抗體分析。

sections.title: Immunoglobulin-Mediated MPGN: Etiologies, Pathogenesis & Workup
sections.content:
Immunoglobulin-Classical Complement Pathway 激活。循環中或局部形成之 Immune Complexes 沉積於 Subendothelial Space 與 Mesangium，吸引 C1q 結合，啟動 C4 及 C2 切割，C4b2a，進而大量消耗 C3 與 C4。因此血清學特徵為 **Low C3 + Low C4**。

###High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Etiologic Subtype | Primary Triggers | Serologic & Laboratory Markers | Characteristic Renal Biopsy Findings |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hepatitis C-Associated MPGN** | HCV RNA infection, Type II Mixed Cryoglobulinemia | HCV RNA(+), Low C4,RF(+), IgM kappa cryoglobulins | Subendothelial deposits, Cryoglobulin plugs in capillary lumens, MPGN pattern |
| **Class IV** |SLE | Anti-dsDNA(+), ANA(+), Low C3 & C4 | Full-house IF (IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q), Subendothelial wire-loop lesions |
| **Infective Endocarditis & Shunt Nephritis** | Staphylococcal / Streptococcal bacteremia, Ventriculovascular shunts | High ASO, positive blood cultures, Low C3 & C4 | Acute exudative MPGN pattern, Subendothelial deposits |
| **MGRS / PGNMID** | Monoclonal Plasma cell / B-cell clone | Serum/Urine SPEP/IFE, sFLR ratio abnormal | Light-typically IgG3 kappa in mesangium and subendothelial space |

###Conceptual Trap Analysis
- **Trap 1**: 勿將 HCV 引起的 Mixed Cryoglobulinemia 誤判為純 C3G！Cryoglobulinemia 會大量消耗 C4，造成極低的 C4 與低/正常 C3；C4 Normal。
- **Trap 2**: 於年長者 (Age > 50) 發現原因不明之 Ig-mediated MPGN 時，即使 SPEP/UPEP 呈陰性，MGRSPGNMID，需進一步執行 Bone Marrow Biopsy 與 IF Light Chain Staining。

Pathophysiology and etiologies of Immunoglobulin-Mediated MPGN: Classical complement pathway activation leading to low serum C3 and C4.

sections.title: Complement-Mediated Glomerulopathy (C3G: C3GN & Dense Deposit Disease)
sections.content:
C3G 為替代補體途徑 (Alternative Complement Pathway, AP) 液相與表面調節失衡所致之嚴重的補體過度激活疾病。Tick-over process，CFHCFI 等 Complement Regulatory Proteins 嚴格抑制。當調節功能崩解，C3bBb 被持續激活並放大，大量消耗血清 C3，而 C4 消耗微乎其微，故典型血清學為 **Low C3 + Normal C4**。

###Pathophysiological Decision Tree

```
Alternative Complement Pathway Dysregulation
 ├── Acquired Autoantibodies
 │    ├──C3NeF: IgG autoantibody binding to C3bBb convertase → Prevents Factor H-mediated decay → Continuous C3 cleavage
 │    ├── Anti-Factor H Autoantibodies: Inhibits regulatory function of Factor H
 │    └── Anti-Factor B / Anti-C3b Autoantibodies
 └── Genetic Aberrations
      ├── Loss-of-function mutations in CFH, CFI,MCP
      ├── Gain-of-function mutations in C3, CFB
      └── Genomic rearrangements in CFHR1-5 gene cluster
```

### DDD vs C3GN 亞型對比

1. **Dense Deposit Disease (DDD, 舊稱 Type II MPGN)**:
   - **EM 特徵**: 於 GBM 之 Lamina Densa 內部呈現極度緻密、連續性、Ribbon-like 之 Osmiophilic Dense Deposits。
   - **全身性表現**: 常伴隨 **Acquired Partial Lipodystrophy** (上半身皮下脂肪萎縮，與 C3NeF 促進脂肪細胞 C3 切割有關) 及 **Retinal Drusen** (視網膜黃斑部沉積物，易引起視力受損)。
2. **C3GN**:
   - **EM 特徵**:Non-ribbon-like，顆粒狀分佈於 Mesangium、Subendothelium 及 Subepithelium。
   - **補體標靶**: 多數伴隨 C5 Convertase 激活與 C5NeF 陽性。

diagrams.caption: Electron micrograph of Dense Deposit Disease (DDD) showing continuous ribbon-like osmiophilic deposits within the lamina densa of the GBM.
Alternative Complement Pathway dysregulation in C3G: C3NeF autoantibody mechanism, DDD vs C3GN EM differences, and retinal drusen / partial lipodystrophy.

sections.title: KDIGO 2021 Guidelines & Targeted Therapeutic Strategies
sections.content:
KDIGO 2021 Glomerular Diseases Guidelines 針對 MPGN 與 C3G 之處置強調以 **Etiology-Targeted Therapy** 為核心：

### KDIGO 處置指引決策流程

1. **General Supportive Care **:
   - 嚴格控制血壓 (Systolic BP $< 120$ mmHg via standardized measurement)。
   -ACEi / ARB 滴定至最大可耐受劑量，搭配 SGLT2 Inhibitors 控制尿蛋白。
   - 限制飲食鈉鹽 ($< 2.0$ g/day) 與低脂控制。

2. **Immunoglobulin-Mediated MPGN 標靶處置**:
   - **HCV-Associated MPGN**: 首選 Direct-DAAs 根除病毒。若伴隨嚴重 Cryoglobulinemic Vasculitis 或 Nephrotic Syndrome，Plasma Exchange。
   - **MGRS-Associated MPGN**: 應由跨科別團隊進行 Clone-Directed Therapy (例如 Bortezomib, Cyclophosphamide, Rituximab 或 Daratumumab)，清除致病性單株 B 淋巴球/漿細胞 clone。
   - **Idiopathic Ig-MPGN**: 僅在伴有 Nephrotic Syndrome 且腎功能持續惡化時，MMF。

3. **C3G 標靶處置**:
   - **中重度疾病 (Proteinuria $> 1.0$ g/day despite supportive care or eGFR decline)**:MMF 作為第一線免疫抑制治療。
   - **頑固性或重症患者**: 考慮使用末端補體抑制劑 **Eculizumab**Anti-C5 monoclonal antibody；新一代補體標靶藥物包括 **Pegcetacoplan**C3/C3b Inhibitor 與 **Iptacopan**Oral Factor B Inhibitor 已在臨床試驗展現顯著療效。
   - **Kidney Transplantation 考量**: C3G 與 DDD 於腎移植後之復發率高達 $50\% - 80\%$。移植前應完整完成補體基因組與自體抗體掃描。
